item.title: Sunflower
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Sunflower Games
  • 発売日: 2020-02-12
  • スコア: 5.55/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Sunflower
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

Alina is a southern belle and loves walking around her sunflower fields near her house. When Alina is not relaxing at her house, she is busy attending LVN University. Alina is a student enrolled in the LVN News Reporting program. With her friends Ivanna and Nadiya, they try their best to investigate a mysterious student that has caused trouble for them in the past.

item.title: LVN Fake News
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Sunflower Games
  • 発売日: 2018-08-21
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: LVN Fake News
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

Nadiya is a new student at LVN University. It has always been her dream to be a video game developer, but when she shows up to her first day of school she finds out that she has accidentally been enrolled in the news program. Not sure what to do, Nadiya tries her best to fit into LVN News. Soon Nadiya discovers that LVN News isn’t what it appears to be on the surface. Her classmates are keeping a deep secret about the true purpose of the program.

  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

After being abroad for 12 years Iosif returns to his home. Having spent most of his life going from place to place Iosif is excited by the prospect of being able to set down some roots. Iosif goes to a local university to complete his education. There he meets an old friend, named Lesya, who is eager to reconnect their friendship. Will Iosif choose to rekindle an old flame or will he find another fire burning in an unexpected place?
